# MLP1 shader smoke fixture

`mlp1-shader-test.p8` is an original test cartridge created for Leaf's shader
qualification harness. It draws a deterministic high-contrast color grid and
text using PICO-8 primitives.

`mlp1-shader-visual-test.p8` adds a full color ramp, neutral steps, a
single-pixel checkerboard, a scrolling one-pixel grid, thin edges, dark and
bright regions, and text for recommendation review.

Both fixtures are dedicated to the public domain under
[CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).
